_comment: Compendium ids for the pf2e documents this module's content references by name. The build rewrites its OWN name-based uuids to ids, but a foreign pack's names it cannot see, and pf2e does not resolve a name-shaped compendium uuid at runtime — it silently returns null and the grant does nothing. Snapshotted from a running pf2e 8.4.1; regenerate with the `Soulbound: Refresh pf2e UUIDs` macro if a system update ever renumbers them (the build fails loudly on an unknown name rather than shipping a dead grant).
